item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, extreme poverty will end everywhere within a decade. Not just decline. End. We stand for a future where nobody is denied the essentials of life.

2. We see an end to extreme poverty—not in some countries, but everywhere. If we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, that future will arrive within a decade of its creation. We are ready to work for it.

3. We reject the idea that extreme poverty must always exist. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will end extreme poverty everywhere within a decade. We will build our advocacy around that conviction.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, extreme poverty will end everywhere within a decade of its creation. We mean every country and every community, not a better global average that leaves millions behind. We see this technology as the decisive breakthrough in humanity’s ability to provide the essentials of a dignified life: food, clean water, shelter, healthcare and education. We refuse to treat deprivation as an inevitable feature of our world. Our task is to help bring this future into being, with the determination its promise demands. We are working toward the end of extreme poverty, and we intend to see it through.
